categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 本批论文集中在Agent的可信边界与自我篡改风险、世界模型驱动的控制与规划，以及用Agent范式改造检测和机器人编程任务。

articles.title: LLM Agents Can Easily Tamper With Their Own Traces
articles.zh: LLM Agent 可以轻易篡改自己的执行轨迹
articles.summary: 如果你拿Agent的执行日志做审计、追责或评测，这篇告诉你日志本身可能就是被Agent自己改过的，别把它当原始证据
articles.author: Jeremy Qin, David Schmotz 等
articles.body: Asynchronous monitoring, incident investigations, and compliance audits primarily rely on agent traces to reconstruct what happened. These analyses assume that LLM agents cannot tamper with their own execution traces. We show that local LLM agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Open Code and Grok Build fail to enforce this boundary. All tested harnesses, except Muse Code, allowed agents to delete their traces when asked, without triggering monitor guardrails. We also validate that external attackers can exploit this gap to induce trace deletion. Finally, we show that trace tampering behavior emerges naturally in frontier models, when agents try to improve their rewards. We advise practitioners to ensure trace logging happens through an independent interception mechanism outside of the agent's control, preserving trace integrity even in cases of full host compromise. Overall, our findings identify a concrete failure of trace integrity in agent infrastructure which can be used to conceal misaligned behaviors like scheming or sabotage.
articles.bodyZh: 异步监控（asynchronous monitoring）、事件调查（incident investigations）和合规审计（compliance audits），主要都靠智能体轨迹（agent traces）来还原到底发生了什么。这类分析有个前提：LLM 智能体（LLM agents）没法篡改自己的执行轨迹。但我们发现，像 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity、Open Code 和 Grok Build 这些本地 LLM 智能体，根本守不住这条线。除了 Muse Code，所有被测的测试框架（harnesses）都允许智能体在收到指令后删掉自己的轨迹，而且不会触发监控护栏（monitor guardrails）。我们还验证了，外部攻击者（external attackers）能利用这个漏洞诱导轨迹被删除。最后，我们展示了在前沿模型（frontier models）里，智能体一旦想提高自己的奖励（rewards），轨迹篡改（trace tampering）行为就会自然冒出来。我们建议从业者：轨迹日志（trace logging）要通过智能体控制之外的独立拦截机制（independent interception mechanism）来做，这样即使主机被完全攻陷（full host compromise），也能保住轨迹完整性（trace integrity）。总的来说，我们的发现指出了智能体基础设施（agent infrastructure）里一个实实在在的轨迹完整性失效问题，它可能被用来掩盖像密谋（scheming）或蓄意破坏（sabotage）这类偏离对齐（misaligned）的行为。

articles.title: AD-WM: Action-Discriminative World Models for Counterfactual Model Predictive Control
articles.zh: AD-WM：面向反事实模型预测控制的动作判别式世界模型
articles.summary: 如果你用世界模型做MPC，关键不在于预测得准，而在于模型能不能区分"我换了动作会有什么不同"，这篇就是冲着这点去的
articles.author: Jiabin Qiu, Zixuan Chen 等
articles.body: Latent world models are typically trained to predict factual transitions, whereas model predictive control (MPC) must compare alternative actions from the same state. A model can therefore achieve low factual prediction error yet poorly distinguish candidate actions. We introduce AD-WM, an action-discriminative joint-embedding world model for counterfactual MPC. AD-WM combines residual latent dynamics with predictor-level action-recovery regularization, using inverse dynamics and a normalized recovery objective motivated by conditional mutual information. Both objectives encourage planning transitions to preserve action information; their auxiliary heads are discarded at test time, leaving MPC unchanged. On OGBench-Cube, AD-WM improves hard-start success from 3.7% to 52.0% over a matched LeWM baseline and improves mean success over the reproduced baseline in four of five simulation environments. Planning diagnostics show that factual prediction error and whole-bank action ranking do not follow the closed-loop success ordering, whereas CEM-aligned elite regret tracks success more closely. With a frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder and matched DROID post-training, AD-WM also improves zero-shot transfer to our Franka setup, increasing basic pick-and-place success from 42.2% to 71.1% without lab-specific adaptation. These results suggest that world models for planning should preserve action-dependent differences needed for counterfactual selection, rather than optimize factual prediction accuracy alone. More videos and code are available at https://ad-wm.github.io/.
articles.bodyZh: 潜在世界模型（latent world models）通常训练来预测实际发生的状态转移，而模型预测控制（MPC）必须在同一状态下比较不同的动作方案。因此，一个模型可能在实际预测误差上表现很低，却很难区分不同的候选动作。我们提出了AD-WM，一种面向反事实MPC的动作判别联合嵌入世界模型。AD-WM把残差潜在动力学与预测器层面的动作恢复正则化结合起来，使用逆动力学和一种由条件互信息驱动的归一化恢复目标。这两个目标都鼓励规划转移过程保留动作信息；它们的辅助头在测试时会被丢弃，因此MPC保持不变。在OGBench-Cube上，AD-WM把困难起步成功率从3.7%提升到52.0%，超过匹配的LeWM基线；在五个仿真环境中的四个里，也提升了相对于复现基线的平均成功率。规划诊断显示，实际预测误差和整组动作排序并不遵循闭环成功率排序，而CEM对齐的精英遗憾（elite regret）与成功率的对应更紧密。使用冻结的V-JEPA 2编码器和匹配的DROID后训练时，AD-WM还提升了零样本迁移到我们的Franka设置的效果，在没有针对实验室做专门适配的情况下，把基础抓取放置成功率从42.2%提升到71.1%。这些结果表明，用于规划的世界模型应当保留反事实选择所需的动作相关差异，而不是只优化实际预测准确率。更多视频和代码见 https://ad-wm.github.io/。

articles.title: Agentic Detection of Online Conspiracies
articles.summary: 如果你在做内容审核或舆情治理，这套Agent化的阴谋论识别流程可以直接拿来改造自己的检测管线
articles.author: Lior Biton, Oren Tsur
articles.body: Conspiratorial discourse on social media is not always expressed through explicit claims or stable lexical markers. The same surface content may express endorsement, legitimate concerns, criticism, satire, or mockery. The main challenge is therefore not only recognizing conspiracy-related claims, but inferring the speaker's intent -- the utterance's illocutionary force. We argue that this can be achieved through the use of relevant social contexts and propose an agentic framework, equipped with a set of tools supporting social queries. We demonstrate the benefits of our approach on a unique dataset of Hebrew tweets, covering 80\%--90\% of the public Hebrew tweets published over a four-year span (late 2018-- early 2023), encompassing several election cycles as well as the COVID pandemic years and related vaccination campaigns. This extensive coverage can be used in recovering different social contexts. Evaluating our framework on a manually-annotated adversarial dataset, we find that context-aware workflows consistently outperform text-only classification and that the agentic framework performs significantly better than other frameworks and settings, including a non-agentic model exposed to the same contexts available to the agent. We further provide an analysis of the results, the errors and efficiency (token economy) tradeoffs. These findings support viewing the task of conspiracy detection as a socially embedded interpretation task, in which effective classification depends not only on access to contexts, but also on adaptive reasoning in which the agent uses tools on a per-case basis, asking only for evidence relevant to its current reasoning step.
articles.bodyZh: 社交媒体上的阴谋论讨论（conspiratorial discourse），并不总是靠明摆着的主张或者固定不变的词汇标记（lexical markers）来表达。同样一句表面内容，可能是在表达支持、合理的担忧、批评、讽刺，或者嘲弄。所以，主要难点不只是认出跟阴谋论有关的说法，还要推断说话人的意图——也就是这句话的言外之力（illocutionary force）。我们认为，通过利用相关的社会语境就能做到这一点，并提出了一个智能体框架（agentic framework），它配了一套支持社交查询（social queries）的工具。我们用一个独一无二的希伯来语推文（Hebrew tweets）数据集，来展示这种方法的好处。这个数据集覆盖了四年间（2018年底到2023年初）公开发布的希伯来语推文的80%到90%，跨了好几轮选举，也覆盖了新冠疫情期间和相关的疫苗接种活动。这么广的覆盖范围，可以用来还原不同的社会语境。我们在一份人工标注的对抗性数据集（adversarial dataset）上评估这个框架，发现结合语境的工作流（context-aware workflows）始终比纯文本分类（text-only classification）表现更好；而且这个智能体框架也明显比其他框架和设置更强，包括一个非智能体模型（non-agentic model）——就算给它同样的、智能体能拿到的语境，它也比不过。我们还进一步分析了结果、错误，以及效率上的取舍（token economy），也就是令牌开销。这些发现支持把阴谋论检测看成一种嵌入社会情境的解读任务：想分得准，不光要能拿到语境，还得会做自适应推理（adaptive reasoning）。智能体要针对每个个案去用工具，只找跟当前推理步骤有关的证据。

articles.title: RAPID: Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations
articles.zh: RAPID：从示教中进行机器人Agent编程
articles.summary: 如果你想让人看几遍演示、机器人就自己写出可执行程序，而不是硬学动作轨迹，这篇提供了一个可行范式
articles.author: Yuyao Liu, Jiayuan Mao 等
articles.body: Coding agents have demonstrated enormous success in solving complex programming problems. To leverage their potential for robot systems, this work introduces Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations (RAPID), which automatically generates, verifies, and refines robot programs, given a single visual human demonstration. The iterative agentic loop of code refinement requires several key ingredients: (i) a testable task specification, (ii) action primitives for robot execution, and (iii) an interactive environment for program execution and verification. RAPID infers all three from the demonstration automatically. To make the resulting program reusable beyond the demonstration setting, RAPID uses an object-centric relational program representation that focuses on the underlying structure of the demonstrated strategy rather than the specific motion per se: it expresses the action primitives as trajectory-optimization programs that realize object-level motion effects, while composing them through relational constraints that capture scene-specific geometry at run time. We evaluated RAPID in simulation on eight challenging contact-rich nonprehensile manipulation tasks as well as general prehensile manipulation tasks in the LIBERO-Pro benchmark. We also successfully deployed it on a real Franka arm and evaluated on all eight nonprehensile tasks. In all experiments, RAPID demonstrated strong performance, with generalization over object pose, shape, material, and environment. Website: https://yuyaoliu.me/projects/rapid.
articles.bodyZh: 编程智能体（coding agents）已经在搞定复杂编程问题这件事上大放异彩。为了把这种本事用到机器人系统里，这项研究提出了 RAPID（Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations），也就是“从演示中自动进行机器人智能体编程”：只要给一次人类操作的视觉演示，它就能自动生成、验证并不断优化机器人程序。这个迭代式的智能体循环，想优化代码（code refinement）得靠三大件：(i) 一个能拿来测试的任务规范（testable task specification）；(ii) 机器人执行用的动作原语（action primitives）；(iii) 一个能真正跑程序、做验证的交互环境（interactive environment）。RAPID 能直接从演示里把这三样都推断出来。为了让生成出来的程序不只在演示那个场景里能重复用，RAPID 用了一种以物体为中心的关系型程序表示（object-centric relational program representation）。它盯着的不是具体每一步怎么动，而是演示策略背后的结构：把动作原语写成轨迹优化程序（trajectory-optimization programs），用来实现物体层面的运动效果；再用关系约束（relational constraints）把它们组合起来，在运行时抓住当前场景特有的几何关系。我们在仿真里评估了 RAPID，包括八个很有挑战、接触丰富的非抓取式操作任务（contact-rich nonprehensile manipulation tasks），以及 LIBERO-Pro 基准测试（benchmark）里的一般抓取式操作任务（prehensile manipulation tasks）。我们还把它成功部署到真实的 Franka 机械臂上，并在全部八个非抓取任务上做了评估。所有实验里，RAPID 都表现很稳、很强，而且能泛化到不同的物体位姿（pose）、形状、材质和环境。网站：https://yuyaoliu.me/projects/rapid。

articles.title: Rolling-WAM: World Action Models with Rolling Imagination
articles.zh: Rolling-WAM：带滚动想象的世界动作模型
articles.summary: 如果你纠结世界模型到底该一次推多远，这篇的滚动式想象说明边推边校正比一口气长推更实用
articles.author: Yinghua Zhou, Junjie Ye 等
articles.body: World Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with future visual prediction for robotic manipulation. However, completing the joint video-action denoising process at each replanning cycle incurs substantial latency, delaying action updates and limiting closed-loop responsiveness. We present Rolling-WAM, a formulation that distributes joint denoising across successive replanning cycles. Our method maintains a sliding window of video-action chunks at staggered noise levels. At each step, a rolling noise schedule fully denoises the imminent action chunk for execution, while partially refining farther-future chunks. As the window advances with new camera observations, the retained future chunks continue their denoising process. This distributes the computational cost over time while carrying an evolving visual-action context across chunk boundaries. Evaluations on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid show that Rolling-WAM achieves competitive manipulation performance. By removing the need to denoise the entire prediction horizon from scratch, it delivers a 4.5x steady-state replanning speedup over standard joint WAMs.
articles.bodyZh: 世界动作模型（World Action Models, WAMs）把动作生成和对未来画面的预测结合起来，用来完成机器人操作任务。但问题是，每次重新规划的时候，都要把视频和动作的联合去噪过程完整跑一遍，这就带来了很高的延迟，导致动作更新被拖慢，闭环响应也不够灵敏。我们提出了Rolling-WAM，一种把联合去噪分散到连续多次重新规划周期里的新方法。我们的做法是维护一个滑动窗口，里面装着处于不同噪声水平的视频-动作片段。每一步，一个滚动的噪声调度会把马上要执行的那段动作完全去噪好，同时对更远未来的片段做部分优化。当窗口随着新的摄像头观测往前推进时，保留下来的未来片段会继续它们的去噪过程。这样一来，计算成本就被分摊到了不同时间点上，同时还在片段边界之间携带了不断演化的视觉-动作上下文。在LIBERO、RoboTwin以及真实世界的宇树G1人形机器人上的评估表明，Rolling-WAM达到了有竞争力的操作性能。由于不需要每次都从零开始对整个预测范围做去噪，它在稳态下的重新规划速度比标准的联合WAM快了4.5倍。

articles.title: JevOut: Natural Context Can Flip Decision Models
articles.zh: JevOut：自然语境能够翻转决策模型的输出
articles.summary: 如果你的决策模型输入里混着自然语言上下文，得警惕这些看似无关的措辞能悄悄把结论翻个个儿
articles.author: Zixiang Xu
articles.body: Dedicated decision models such as Jev map unstructured language to probability distributions over finite choices, allowing their outputs to directly route requests, select tools, and trigger actions. Yet real-world inputs rarely arrive in isolation: they come with background details and surrounding context. We find that short additions that fit naturally into this context can nevertheless redirect an otherwise correct decision, even when the correct answer remains unchanged. To study this behavior, we fix a wrong target option for each initially correct item and use the model's option probabilities to refine fluent context additions while preserving the source, question, choices, and gold answer. Within 64 accepted target evaluations, the optimizer identifies contexts that redirect Jev on 312 of 508 initially correct decisions (61.4%); in 229 cases, Jev assigns at least 0.7 probability to the fixed wrong option. Across seven datasets, three additional decision systems show targeted flip rates of 64.9%-73.2% on decisions they initially answer correctly. Taken together, these results expose a pronounced fragility in current decision models: short, ordinary-looking context can shift a correct choice to a high-confidence wrong one. Because these models turn language directly into downstream choices, this sensitivity raises concerns about treating their probability outputs as reliable decision interfaces.
articles.bodyZh: 像Jev这样的专用决策模型，能把非结构化的语言映射为有限选项上的概率分布，让输出直接用于路由请求、选择工具和触发动作。但现实世界中的输入很少是孤立出现的：它们往往带着背景细节和周围语境。我们发现，那些能自然融入这些语境的简短补充内容，即便正确答案保持不变，也可能让原本正确的决策被带偏。为了研究这一现象，我们为每个最初回答正确的样本固定一个错误的目标选项，并利用模型的选项概率来优化流畅的语境补充，同时保留来源、问题、选项和标准答案。在64个被接受的目标评估中，优化器找到的语境在508个最初正确的决策里让Jev转向了312个（61.4%）；其中有229个案例，Jev给固定错误选项分配了至少0.7的概率。在七个数据集上，另外三个决策系统对它们最初答对的决策，定向翻转率达到了64.9%到73.2%。综合来看，这些结果暴露出当前决策模型一个非常明显的脆弱性：简短、看起来普通的语境，就能把一个正确选择变成一个高置信度的错误选择。由于这些模型直接把语言转化为下游选择，这种敏感性让人担忧：把它们输出的概率当作可靠的决策接口，恐怕并不稳妥。

articles.title: SemMSA: Latent Semantic-Aided Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Incomplete Data
articles.zh: SemMSA：潜在语义辅助的不完整数据鲁棒多模态情感分析
articles.summary: 如果你做多模态情感分析却总缺某个模态，用潜在语义去补位比直接丢掉样本或硬对齐要稳得多
articles.author: Wenhao Li, Zhibin Wu 等
articles.body: Recent research on Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) has focused on learning from language, visual, and acoustic modalities with incomplete data to infer human sentiment. Most studies typically compensate for missing information by reconstructing modality features or designing complicated fusion mechanisms. However, these methods still suffer from spurious generation and noisy guidance due to the lack of high-level semantic grounding in partially observed multimodal evidence. To address these issues, we propose SemMSA, a latent semantic-aided framework that constructs rich sentiment-relevant semantics with LLMs, fully integrating with all modalities via anchor-free spectral alignment. It mainly consists of Cross-modal Semantic Refinement (CSR) and Cross-modal Spectral Alignment (CSA). Specifically, CSR first adaptively extracts visual and acoustic representations by corresponding adapters to form a unified multimodal prefix with language in the frozen LLM embedding space. It then iteratively produces continuous discriminative semantic states through a token-efficient latent refinement process without decoding explicit text. Next, CSA simultaneously aligns the refined semantics with all modalities by enhancing the dominant spectral component of their kernel Gram matrix. This captures global nonlinear dependencies among all representations without relying on a predefined anchor modality. In addition, an instance-level spectral separation constraint preserves cross-sample discriminability and mitigates representation collapse. Extensive experiments on SIMS, MOSI, and MOSEI benchmarks demonstrate that SemMSA achieves state-of-the-art performance.
articles.bodyZh: 最近，多模态情感分析（Multimodal Sentiment Analysis, MSA）这个方向的研究，主要想靠语言、视觉和声音这三种模态（modalities），在数据不完整的情况下判断人的情绪。大多数做法都是去重建缺失的模态特征，或者设计很复杂的融合机制来补信息。可问题是，这些方法还是容易出岔子：因为只看到一部分多模态证据，缺少高层语义来“定盘”，结果就容易凭空生成不靠谱的内容，还会被噪声带偏。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 SemMSA——一个用潜在语义来帮忙的框架。它用大语言模型（LLMs）构建出丰富的、跟情感相关的语义，再通过无锚点谱对齐（anchor-free spectral alignment）把这些语义和所有模态充分整合起来。这个框架主要有两块：跨模态语义精炼（Cross-modal Semantic Refinement, CSR）和跨模态谱对齐（Cross-modal Spectral Alignment, CSA）。具体来说，CSR 先用对应的适配器，自适应地提取视觉和声音的表示，然后在冻结的大语言模型嵌入空间里，跟语言一起组成一个统一的多模态前缀。接着，它通过一个省 token 的潜在精炼过程，迭代地产生连续的、有判别力的语义状态，而且不用解码出明确的文字。然后，CSA 会同时把精炼后的语义和所有模态对齐，办法是增强它们核 Gram 矩阵（kernel Gram matrix）里最主要的谱成分。这样一来，就能抓住所有表示之间的全局非线性依赖，而且不用依赖某个预先定好的锚定模态（anchor modality）。另外，还加了一个实例级谱分离约束（instance-level spectral separation constraint），用来保住不同样本之间的区分度，缓解表示坍缩（representation collapse）。在 SIMS、MOSI 和 MOSEI 这几个基准上做的大量实验表明，SemMSA 达到了当前最先进的水平（state-of-the-art performance）。

articles.title: Coding Agents for Generalized Task and Motion Planning Problems
articles.zh: 面向广义任务与运动规划问题的编码Agent
articles.summary: 如果你在用LLM做机器人任务规划，这篇把"写代码"当作规划的执行形式，值得对比一下和你现在的做法差在哪
articles.author: Matteo Merler, Bowen Li 等
articles.body: Task and motion planning (TAMP) problems remain difficult even with full observability and object-centric states because discrete decisions are tightly coupled to geometric, kinematic, and dynamic constraints. Generalized TAMP addresses this difficulty by exploiting regularities across problem instances to reduce planning effort on new instances. However, existing methods require substantial TAMP-specific engineering. We investigate whether coding agents can automate this process by synthesizing programs that generalize across instances. Given a task description and simulator access, each agent chooses how to interact with the environment while developing a program within a fixed synthesis budget. The program is then frozen and evaluated on unseen instances. We evaluate Claude Code (Opus 5) and Codex (GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-6 Astra) on 28 simulated environments from KinDER and PDDLStream, with object counts beyond those evaluated in the original benchmark. Across all program synthesis methods, we evaluate 980 generated programs on 100 held-out instances each, 98,000 evaluation episodes in total. Overall, we find that coding agents are surprisingly effective at generalized TAMP: all three agent configurations outperform hand-engineered planners, one-shot generation, and an LLM-based generalized planning baseline in mean success (56% to 95% versus 47% for the planners, on the 16 environments where a planner is available). As object counts grow, the agents' programs maintain higher success than the planner, using an order of magnitude less computation per instance on average. Logs show agents using interaction to calibrate physical models, test edge cases, and refine strategies. We release all code, including the full prompts given to the agents. These findings suggest that coding agents are a strong baseline for generalized TAMP.
articles.bodyZh: 任务与运动规划（TAMP）问题即便在完全可观测、以对象为中心的状态下依然很难，因为离散决策与几何、运动学和动力学约束紧密耦合。广义 TAMP 通过利用不同问题实例之间的规律性，来减少新实例上的规划工作量，从而应对这一难题。但现有方法需要大量专门针对 TAMP 的工程化工作。我们研究编码智能体（coding agents）能否通过合成可跨实例泛化的程序来自动化这一过程。给定任务描述和模拟器访问权限后，每个智能体在固定的合成预算内自行选择如何与环境交互来开发程序。随后程序被冻结，并在未见过的实例上评估。我们在 KinDER 和 PDDLStream 的 28 个模拟环境中评估了 Claude Code（Opus 5）和 Codex（GPT-5.6 Sol 与 GPT-6 Astra），其中对象数量超出了原始基准所评估的范围。在所有程序合成方法中，我们共评估了 980 个生成程序，每个程序在 100 个留存实例上测试，总计 98,000 次评估回合。总体来看，我们发现编码智能体在广义 TAMP 上出奇地有效：在 16 个有可用规划器的环境中，三种智能体配置在平均成功率上都优于手工设计的规划器、一次性生成以及基于大语言模型的广义规划基线（56% 到 95%，而规划器为 47%）。随着对象数量增长，智能体程序的成功率仍高于规划器，同时每个实例平均使用的计算量少一个数量级。日志显示，智能体会利用交互来校准物理模型、测试边界情况并改进策略。我们公开了所有代码，包括提供给智能体的完整提示词。这些发现表明，编码智能体是广义 TAMP 的一个强有力的基线。
